primary.title: Should you wait for a market fall before starting a mutual fund SIP? What 30 years of Sensex data reveal
primary.summary: Waiting for a market correction before starting a mutual fund SIP may cost investors valuable investment time. A WhiteOak Capital analysis of nine market cycles found that starting earlier often led to a higher final corpus, despite marginally lower returns.
